import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Sketch")

# Create a sketch object
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")

# Set the sketch plane to XY (0, 0, 1 is normal for XY plane)
sketch.MapMode = "FlatFace"
sketch.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Rotation(0, 0, 0, 1))

# Add a horizontal line segment 10 mm long in the XY plane
# Start at origin (0, 0), end at (10, 0)
sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(10, 0, 0)), False)

# Constrain the line to be horizontal (optional but good practice for "normal-geometry")
# Get the geometry index of the line we just added (should be 0)
geo_idx = 0

# Add horizontal constraint
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Horizontal", geo_idx))

# Recompute the document
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Sketch created and saved successfully.")
print(f"Number of geometries: {len(sketch.Geometry)}")
print(f"Number of constraints: {len(sketch.Constraints)}")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF
python3 create_sketch.py"}
